mentions.name: Samosa Math
mentions.description: This tool audits mathematical derivations step by step, checking for mistakes in derivations written by a person or produced with AI assistance.
mentions.problem: Mistakes in mathematical derivations, whether written by humans or AI, are easy to miss.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on a derivation step auditor for checking any mistakes in your (or your AI buddy's) mathematical derivations!

https://samosa-math.vercel.app/
mentions.author: Hussain04
